ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=kx+b$ ($k<0$) passes through the point $P(2,0)$. What is the range of $x$ when $kx+b>0$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} The line $y=kx+b$ ($k<0$) passes through the point $P(2,0)$.\\
When $kx+b>0$, the range of $x$ is $x<2$,\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x<2}$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: it shows a straight line with negative slope passing through the x-axis at P, labeled with x-coordinate 2.
